scope.model: Each named raw byte value selects an unknown fixed GP29 alphabet. The key remains synchronized; source phase-averaged Dirichlet-multinomial score is label-free.
scope.source_dependency: Exactly the 50 Stage S LP2 key/alignment rows required by Stage W were regenerated with pinned Stage S _decode. Stage S original broad run was void; these rows are only a numerical dependency, not a valid Stage S conclusion.
scope.grid: Five raw-byte key classings from wisdom hint forward/reverse and page_17/page_21/page_43 payloads. Ten alignments: each section 7 through 15 and joined 7-15. All source phases per key.
scope.controls: Five same-length random-alphabet positives and five flat additive negatives per key/alignment (500), plus one shuffled-key LP2 null per key (5); anti-doublet keep=0.19.
scope.decision: VOID if any flat negative or null mean score >=30. A setting is testable only if all five positives score >=30; PASS if its LP2 score >=30, otherwise EXCLUDED if testable, else untestable.
scope.exclusions: Other Stage S classings, key skips/resets, different letter mappings, layers, alternate transcriptions and control sources.
